definitions.explanation: A person who takes part in a crime together with others, either by committing it jointly or by helping. Common in crime news and mystery fiction; also used jokingly of someone who shares a small secret or mischief.

examples.japanese: {共犯者|きょうはんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共犯者|きょうはんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The police believe there was an accomplice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{内緒|ないしょ}→内緒：03126_naisho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共犯者|きょうはんしゃ}だ。
examples.english: We ate the cake without telling Mom, so my little brother and I are partners in crime.

notes:
⟦{共犯|きょうはん}→共犯：11687_kyouhan⟧ (complicity, joint crime) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). ⟦{共犯|きょうはん}→共犯：11687_kyouhan⟧ alone can also name the person.
